The host was extremely friendly and helpful, no inconvenience at all.
You can tell the house was decorated by a professional and everything seems like it was placed intentionally and gracefully.

name: Natasha
text: Great! The place was clean, cozy, and welcoming. The kids really enjoyed themselves and stayed entertained with all the activities provided.

name: Maribel

text: I went to Edwards place to celebrate my bday along with my family & we had such a memorable time at this place, lots to do inside. private space. It was worth every penny. we cant wait to go back again.

name: Felix
text: Had an amazing time kids love the area and the house. Kept them busy with all the games and activities.

name: Eddie
text: The stay was good overall. The home was a nice size, spacious, and clean. It was a little dated considering the price, but everything else was fine. Most importantly, the kids had a great time, and I was able to relax and enjoy the stay.

name: Yolanda
text:
We had a wonderful stay! The house is beautiful, very clean, and thoughtfully decorated. The cheerful decor throughout the home really makes you feel happy and welcome.

The host was extremely responsive and attentive. When we couldn’t find the balls for the foosball table, a new box of balls was at our door within minutes! That level of care and hospitality was truly appreciated.

We stayed the weekend of August 21, and unfortunately, the weather wasn’t warm enough to enjoy the outdoor pool. However, we had a great time relaxing in the hot tub and enjoying all the games in the basement.

We enjoyed our stay very much and would definitely recommend this beautiful home to others!

name: Moreeyah
text: My family had a wonderful time. The place was perfect for our needs and our kids did not get bored for a moment. It was easy to contact the host and he was very helpful with whatever we needed. I would definitely go again.

name: Kathy
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Long Pond! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The property was great, clean, comfortable, and in a very convenient location. All the shopping, and places to eat were close by, which made everything so easy and convenient.

The host was very friendly, welcoming, and easy to communicate with. Communication throughout our stay was excellent, and the host was always responsive and helpful whenever we had a question.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Long Pond! We would happily stay here again!

name: Lillian
text: I had such an amazing time this weekend! I honestly think the house looked 100 percent better in person lol. There were lots of wildlife as mentioned such as deers in the mornings and bears 🐻 at night. I will definitely come again, only complain is that the pool was super cold and the weather wasn’t as hot, but we still enjoyed. Thank you Edward for hosting us, you were great and very attentive with any concerns I reached out about. Definitely will book again.

name: Ravshan
text: Nice clean felt like home friendly host really liked it I would suggest to others to visit as well because it was right price as well.

name: Charity
text:
The house was very vibrant, warm and inviting.
The host responded quickly to any of our concerns. It was close to the highway and close to many towns. The kids loved it and it was very spacious.

name: Joshua
text: The place was spacious, VERY bright. It was nice and cold but maybe too cold. The tvs were nice and the yard was very relaxing.

name: Joanna
text: We had an amazing stay here! This place had all the accommodations plus things to do while we had rainy days. The pool is a plus which we enjoyed the first night. Dinner and movie nights inside and then a little game of pool. Edward was super helpful and responsive.

name: Matt
text: We had a family get-together over the weekend, with kids aged 1 to 13, and everyone had a great time. The house was full of activities, so there was something for all to enjoy.

name: Sarah
text: Overall, the place was great. Had some issues with the hot tub, but the hosts said they would work on it. The bed was very comfy and the outdoor area was quiet and peaceful. The deer in the neighborhood was an extra bonus.

name: Shaleen
text: Had a great stay kids loved it would recommend to anyone

name: Rosemarie
text: Edward was an excellent host and provided me with all the necessary details needed to make my families stay stress free. He answered my questions quickly and made me feel at ease. The house was clean , spacious , and lots to do especially with kids and we didn’t have to leave the house for entertainment. The supermarket was 7 minutes away which was a plus for us !! What you see in the photos is exactly what you’ll see in the house. The basement had an amazing setup for entertainment ! We will definitely rebook and I highly recommend Edward’s place !!!!

name: Heath
text: I stayed with 7 other people here for 5 days and every day we had something to do and it was always a peaceful, relaxing, clean, and overall amazing place to come back to. It had many activities to do even at the house we were never bored. And it was in a great location as well and most attractions were drivable with no issues or worries. Edward was also very great with communicating with us and always keeping us in the loop and was very quick to answer any of our questions. I would highly recommend staying here or any other place Edward has to offer.

name: Silvestre
text: Our family had a wonderful stay and truly enjoyed our time here. The host was fantastic—welcoming, attentive, and went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. We would gladly stay again and highly recommend this property to others.

name: Lourdes
text: The place was amazing a lot of stuff to do inside since the weather wasn’t really on our side but everything was just like Edward said, so thank you for having us!

name: Wei
text:
We had such an amazing stay at this house! The entire place has a super fun and colorful vacation vibe that instantly puts you in a good mood. The design is funky in the best way possible — every room feels unique and thoughtfully decorated, making the house feel like an experience instead of just a place to sleep.

The new amenities were a huge hit with everyone in our group. The mini golf area was so much fun for both adults and kids, and the kids absolutely loved the climbing wall and play features. There was always something to do, which made the stay extra memorable.

The pool area was definitely one of our favorite parts of the property. It felt like a private resort and was perfect for relaxing during the day and hanging out at night. The whole outdoor setup really gives you that true getaway feeling.

The house was clean, spacious, and packed with entertainment. You can tell the host put a lot of effort into creating a unique and enjoyable experience for guests. We would absolu

name: Vincent
text:
This was one of the most unique Airbnb stays we’ve had. The house feels like a true vacation destination instead of a typical rental. The colorful and creative design made the entire place feel fun, energetic, and welcoming.

Our kids were entertained the whole trip with the climbing wall, mini golf, and all the activity spaces around the house. Meanwhile, the adults enjoyed relaxing by the pool and spending quality time together without needing to leave the property much at all.

The home was spacious, clean, and clearly designed for groups and families to make memories together. Every area of the house had its own personality and vibe. We left with so many great photos and memories from this trip. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a fun and different Pocono getaway!

name: Ruby
text:
We had such a wonderful stay at this beautiful home in Long Pond and truly couldn’t have asked for a better getaway for our family. From the moment we arrived, everything felt warm, welcoming, and thoughtfully prepared. The house was spotless, very comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing — if anything, even better in person.

The space was perfect for traveling with kids and made our family feel right at home. There was plenty of room for everyone to relax, play, and spend quality time together. The location was also excellent — close enough to local attractions and outdoor activities while still feeling private and serene.

The host was fantastic throughout the entire experience. Communication was quick, friendly, and helpful, and it was clear that a lot of care goes into making guests feel comfortable. We highly recommend this home to anyone looking for a clean, cozy, family-friendly place to stay in the Poconos area!

name: Mohamed
text: Came for a weekend getaway, had a wonderful time at a wonderful house

name: Tyquan
text: Me and my family enjoyed our stay. It was a beautiful trip and a great home to stay at during our family trip.

name: Yhariixa
text: This place is exactly like the photos. The furniture is a little outdated but it feel right at home. Kids enjoyed both movie theaters and the play room. The house is extremely spacious and honestly probably fits more than 12 ppl. The host was very responsive to any needs we had. Would stay here again

name: Olivia
text: Me and my friends had a amazing stay! We loved the house!

name: Michelle
text: Edward's place was an ideal getaway. The house was well-located, clean, well-maintained, and had great amenities. Edward was very responsive and attentive to our needs during our stay. Since we were visiting in the winter (with lots of snow on the ground), we didn't get to experience the pool or fire pit. We did enjoy the jacuzzi, sauna, and game room. It's a perfect location for family visits, and my teens really enjoyed themselves. While I don't have much feedback for improvements, a few minor things that could help would be stocking supplies like paper towels (I brought my own), refreshing the board games (Monopoly was missing pieces), and including instructions for how to navigate heating the lower level of the house (which was sometimes chilly), and for re-engaging the lock on the front door (but Edward helped us with this). Other than that, I would strongly recommend this location - the setup was great for a family and friend getaway. Great stay!

name: Nick
text: The house was spacious and had a lot of great amenities. The host was very responsive and easy to get ahold of in case we needed anything. All in all this was the best Airbnb I have stayed at so far.

name: Amanda
text: Great place!!! Definitely does not fit more than 4 cars, but huge house and responsive host! Would definitely come back again.

text: Amazing home, and great host. Eddie helped me in any issue we had during our stay. The home is amazing, 2 “gaming” rooms with one having a jacuzzi was sweet deal ! Would definitely stay here again. Thank you to Eddie again for allowing us to stay at your home !!! 🔥

text: Everything was great for the most part! The sheets did smell like it spent more time in the wash sitting than drying, which led to a wet smell.

name: Celeste
text: Host was friendly, responsive and helpful. The house matched the description and was fun for a bachelorette. My group and I felt it didn’t have all of the amenities it should - no hand towels, no aluminum or plastic wrap, not a lot of cleaning supplies on-hand like Clorox wipes for example, etc. — things we felt other Airbnb’s usually have. The location was relatively close to Blue Ridge Winery, Big Pocono State Park, and Main St., Stroudsburg. If you have a lowkey group, I think it’s a viable option.

Additionally, the property has a hot tub and a sauna for relaxation. It’s located less than ten minutes from Kalahari and Walmart, my family enjoyed our stay, and I look forward to returning in the future.

name: Gabe
text: Great place for a weekend with a few friends! Hot tub was great along with theatre room, lots to do

name: Dawn
text: Thank you for making our family get together a very memorable weekend . The house is very clean , great amenities , fun for all ages . Ed is extremely informative and responsive . We will be back !

text: Had an absolute amazing time at Edward’s airbnb! My college friends and I went for the weekend and were blown away by how stunning it is. Edward was super nice, responsive and very helpful. We cannot wait to book again next year!

name: Hetal
text: Edward was very fast at replying when we needed to ask any questions! The place was very nice with my favorite being in the indoor jacuzzi. Lots of games such as pool, jenga, ping pong and football. There’s even a poker table with chips and cards. 10/10 play to stay!

name: Adrienne
text: Such a great house & great host! Everything looked just like it was described and our group of 12 was so happy and comfortable! Eddie was so fast to respond and even the one time we had trouble getting into the supply closet, he went and sent us a Walmart delivery with the things we were looking for.

name: Gregory
text: Everyone in our group really enjoyed Edwards place. We were all very pleased with the home, location and amenities provided. Would definitely stay here again next time we’re in the Poconos. Thanks!

name: Steven
text: This place was exactly what we were looking for and exactly as advertised. Hose Eddie was quick to respond to all and any questions we had prior to and even after arriving. The property was large enough for our family and then some. We highly recommend this place and will give it another visit in the summer to enjoy the outdoor space. The only negative was we couldn't stay longer. 5 STARS well earned!!

name: Tarah
text: I can't say enough good things about Eddie! From the time we booked until after our trip he was extremely responsive and friendly! We celebrated the New Year and an amazing time. There were 6 adults and 6 kids, and there was plenty of space for everyone! The kids really enjoyed the hot tub/movie room. It's centrally located, within minutes of Kalahari, and about 20 minutes to Camelback and JackFrost/Big Boulder. Would definitely stay here again!

name: Daphne
text: We had a great stay. There were so many games available for the kids to enjoy. The location was perfect for the activities we had planned at Camelback Mountain, so the commute was very easy. We even had a few wilderness friends (2 beautiful deer) come and visit us. We were able to use the hot tub being that it was enclosed, however, the chlorine levels were incredibly high and it made it very difficult to stay in for more than 10 minutes or so. Overall, our experience was excellent, and we will definitely return in the future.

name: Sharday
text: My family and myself had a splended stay for Christmas 🎄

name: Celia
text: It’s always a pleasure staying at one of Edward’s houses. Edward is a great host, quick to respond, and keeps his rentals clean. We will be back!

name: Tionia
text: Edward was a very accommodating host. The place was beautiful and very clean. Lots of stores and activities near by. Highly recommend!

name: Celia
text: Edward was super accommodating and helpful. The house was clean and exactly as described. We would stay here again!

name: Mei

text: This was our first Airbnb experience and it didn’t disappoint. The pictures and listed amenities were as posted. Very spacious and clean space. Responsive host. Beautiful location. Having washer dryer when traveling with kids was also a plus! Only feedback was that the place smelled “moth-like” for a lack of a better word. It was very clean and organized but maybe due to it being locked up for long periods of time between guests that smell was initially noticeable. Having some febreeze handy will do the trick.

name: Vanessa
text: We had a great time staying at this property! Eddie was a fantastic host—very responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which we really appreciated. The house had plenty of space for 4 teenagers and 3 adults. While it could use a little extra attention in terms of maintenance and inventory, none of this took away from our overall enjoyment. We made some great memories here and would recommend it for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway. Thanks again for hosting us, Eddie!

name: Linda
text: Edward is an exceptional host , quick to respond and very informative , Addresses concerns immediately. Space is comfy and great for all gatherings.

name: Matthew
text: The place was clean and quiet. But the projectors are hard to use/unusable. The room doors wouldn’t close properly, there weren’t enough towels if you are going to use them pool/hot tub. Some bathrooms don’t have shampoo or body soap and there are no napkins/tissues as well. Overall, I had a great time, but definitely could had been better.

name: Richard
text: The house was beautiful, very roomy, and great kitchen. Me n my guest also enjoyed grilling on the deck and roasting marshmallows at the fire pit. Edward was responsive and very nice host, I recommend this place for anyone with a large group or couples getaway.

name: Kosal
text: Nothing but great things to say about Eddie’s spot! Had a great time with family and friends and will be recommending others to come to this magnificent mini getaway.

The place was beautiful, the host was very responsive and helpful. What I loved about the place was that I was able to take my two dogs without having them to be on a cage.
The only thing that I didn’t like was that the house was not clean at all (bathrooms, kitchen, floor, rugs, the green pillow had dog hair). I hoped that the house would it be clean before we arrived.
I would come back because I loved the house, hopefully next the the house will be clean.

text: This is a great place for large groups due to the spacious and comfortable common room, and the many fun amenities. The beds were very comfortable and the kitchen quite well equipped. We must add that Edward might be the most responsive host we've ever encountered.

name: Jennifer
text: It was a wonderful stay, and I would stay again and for longer!

text: Overall, great space for a large group. The home was equipped with plenty of activities and the space was large enough for an entire group to take part in each activity. Edward was extremely helpful and communicative , would definitely be willing to book again !

Edward asked for feedback at the end of our stay to make sure the next guests will be just as happy as we were. 10/10 dont hesitate to book. Also Kalahari was very close around a 10 mins drive.

text: The amount of indoor entertainment for the kids was just astounding. The place wasn't far from the rest of local businesses in case you need additional groceries and refreshments. The rooms were comfortable and the place has a washing machine and dryer if you need to wash laundry. Overall, the best way to describe the place is cozy and I personally recommend it!

name: Diane
text: Location is great. Restaurants, breweries, shopping, and grocery stores were within 8-10 minutes away. House is great for 2 small families for a peaceful getaway. Amenities within the house were great! My kids loved the theater room, foosball and pool table!

name: Kyle
text: Great location secluded enough but also close enough to shops/stores. Had a ton of amenities like the hot tub, sauna, pool, ping pong as well as great community spaces to hang out with friends/family. Would recommend.

name: Mutasim
text: We had the time of our lives just chilling in that place

name: Nickie
text: My daughter and her friends stayed here for a week and absolutely loved it. The house was gorgeous, spacious and very clean, the host was extremely responsive, and the house itself had so many things to do—hot tub, movie projectors, fire pit, pool and more. I would definitely rent this house again.

name: Jennifer
text: First let me say that this house had ALOT to do so we never bored. It was nicely decorated and spacious. With that said my group did find some cons. The house is advertised for up to 12 guests but when we got there didn’t even have enough bath towels for my group of 8. There were no hand towels in any of the bathrooms to dry your hands after washing them. The cleanliness in the kitchen wasn’t great. We also noticed that there was no cleaning supplies to wipe anything up if we had spilled anything. And what we also found to be lacking was there was no book or anything welcoming you, giving directions on how to use certain things like the fireplace etc or even giving you restaurants or things to do in the area. My group and I do this trip yearly and loved the location and things to do I the house but it found it a bit lacking in the above.

text: Eddie’s place was great. The rooms were spacious and the interior felt cosy. We enjoyed the amenities. Very convenient to the groceries and activities. Only downside was the shower where it did not have a strong pressure and water would be limited.

name: Harley
text:
We just had the most awesome Friendsgiving at Edward's place in the Poconos! Right from the start, Edward was super friendly and helpful, making sure we had all the info we needed for a great stay.

The house was perfect for our group – it felt like our own little cozy corner in the mountains. We spent loads of time in the kitchen, which had everything we needed to whip up our Friendsgiving feast.

The bedrooms were super comfy, queen size beds in every room were very appreciated. The place combines this cool rustic vibe with all the modern stuff you need, so it was like the best of both worlds.

We are deeply grateful for the hospitality and the exceptional environment provided. We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking to create special moments in the beautiful Poconos. We're already looking forward to our next visit!

name: Michelle
text: Great host, beautiful home, lots of activities available in the home. Will definitely return

name: Zac
text: Wonderful place if you’re bring about a dozen people or so. Great social spaces and quiet surroundings.

name: Brianna
text: Wow! This home has everything you can need and want! Ideal location for a perfect getaway. 10 out of 10! Would definitely come back and recommend!

name: Maritza
text: The house was exactly as listed. Edward was responsive. The house had everything we needed. Would rent again.

name: Cristian
text: We went for a friend's birthday and had a great time. Particularly, the bedding situation was great; there was space for everyone and then some. You can find a Walmart and shops 10 mins away and an outlet 20 mins away which is a nice extra.

name: Akanksha
text:
Great property! Well equipped kitchen.
We had minor issue with the hot tub. Eddie responded the issue immediately and got it sorted.
We had a great time here.

name: Alex
text: Ed was an excellent host. We had a rainy weekend, but there was a lot to do at the house. Appreciate the quick communication and follow up

name: Joelky
text:
The place was comfortable, it had all the necessary kitchen utensils, my group appreciated the towels and hygiene items that were provided, the mini heaters helped a lot since the central heat at 90 did not warm up enough.

The only complain was that the water was never warm enough, it was always mild even when we scheduled our showers.

Thanks for having us.

name: Nhi
text: Host was very good at communication. Place was nice, clean and accurate as description. Would recommend for you to book a stay here for a nice getaway !

name: Ivan
text: Thanks to Eddie and Co. my family and I had a great stay but must say if your faint of heart be mindful it really is Bear country 1 morning we woke up to a broken fence and rummaged garbage that was clearly done by a bear but my crazy family thought it was cool lol

name: Yolanda
text: Beautiful property. Huge interior. Kitchen had almost all necessary utensils and conveniences. Well-kept, beautiful, huge backyard with firepit (my personal favorite) Big, sparkling clean pool! Fun for kids and adult kids alike. So many things to do inside, like others mentioned you don't even have to leave the house for entertainment. I had to be dragged out for shopping. More positives to say but i don't want to write a book. Would definitely book again. Thanks Eddie!

name: Will
text: Great house and great host. Thanks Eddie!

name: Jaron
text: Place was great for our group. The place was a fantastic stay and highly recommended for groups looking to just relax

name: Margaret
text: We recently returned from a four day stay - 11 of us ranging in age from 73 to 2 years. The home was clean, well-stocked and comfortably accommodated us all with lots for all ages to enjoy. Eddie was responsive and very helpful. Location was great and we enjoyed the community facilities - lakes and pool.

name: Kimberly
text: Eddie was a great host everything was great only thing was the neighbor was annoying complaining at 8:30 cause the music was playing while we were out in the yard in the pool when it clearly says quiet time from 10pm to 8am and it was only 8:30 and the music wasn’t even loud !

name: Vee
text: Great house with a lot of amenities, highly recommended

name: Anum
text: Great stay. Only negative was having to plan out showers due to not having hot water at all times. With big groups/kids, that can be a big problem.

name: Tanika
text: Eddie was responsive. Fast and efficient. So the stay when smoothly.

name: Sumer
text: Great stay and great host! Place was clean and spacious. Amenities for days!

name: Christian
text: Beautiful home ! Me and my family had an amazing time, great place for a getaway to just relax! Very clean and so many things to do inside the house ! Definitely recommend !

name: Nadege
text: Eddie was such a great and responsive host. Any concern my guest and I had was immediately tended to. The rooms were as pictured in the listing and the home was very clean.

name: Manal
text: eddie was a responsive host answering any question I had within minutes. Loved our stay would definitely come again with my family.

name: Dylan
text: Place was nice. Previous occupants to us broke some of the appliances and the back door which there wasn't enough time to fix before we got there.

name: Igor
text: Eddie provided an awesome experience for us! Had an incredible time

name: Ivan

text: This home was beautiful to stay at! There were 8 of us staying here and the home was able to accommodate all of us comfortably. The pool, fire pit, pool table, and etc were really nice additions to the home and gave us endless things to do inside. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely like to come back for another getaway trip!

name: Christopher
text: My friends and I had a little getaway at Eddie’s place, and it was the perfect spot to chill out and have fun. We utilized nearby attractions and the house was a great home base to come back to!

Looks as good as the pictures!
Quite and peaceful.

name: Eden
text: Eddie was a wonderful host: responsive and helpful the entire time we were there. He was also really responsive to feedback. The place was quiet and peaceful and the hot tub was a relaxing getaway and it was cool to be able to watch movies from it! We definitely plan on coming back next year!

name: Melissa
text: Our stay was great! More than enough room for 7 people, great amenities, quiet location. Artfully decorated, would definitely stay again

name: Joan
text: My friends and I celebrated my 50th birthday this weekend. It was exactly what we all needed. We all had enough space for ourselves but still felt close. There were a few hiccups in the beginning, but the hosts were quick to respond and easily helped us fix any issues. They seem to be upgrading a few things. So, whoever comes next will be pretty lucky. If we all had more time, I believe we would've stayed longer! I will definitely be booking again with Eddie again!

name: Lake
text: The place was absolutely beautiful and looked exactly like the pictures. Eddie is very responsive and helpful. We couldn't have asked for a more lovely stay.

name: Susan
text: Eddie responded instantly to our communications and addressed everything .the house was great and we enjoyed the backyard. Easy to get to.

name: Taylor
text: Eddie was a great host and the house was great.

name: Christian

name: Ryan
text: Eddie’s place was awesome! So many great amenities and features to keep us occupied, and a short 15 minute drive from all main attractions. We will definitely look to stay here again!

name: John
text: Awesome house. Would highly recommend. Everything worked perfectly and the house was very comfortable. We will be back!

name: Janine
text: Good for large groups very close to kalahari

name: Tom
text: Eddie was helpful when some technical issues with the A/V in the house weren't working well. The house comfortably held five adults and four insane children with room and activities to spare.

name: Tamisha
text: AWESOME HOUSE & HOST WILL GO BACK AGAIN...

name: Stephanie
text: This house was perfect for our annual family ski weekend - lots of space and activities to do nearby. Eddie was a very responsive host!

name: Monique
text: This is a beautiful home. It is worth the stay. Very roomy and many activities to do in house. Beware the wildlife warning is true. We had several close encounters. Eddie responds quickly. For a large group showers need to be spaced apart big time as hot water does not accommodate the large group ( it runs out fast) if your not the first person to shower you may be upset. There are a lot of rules posted throughout the house which will make you a little anxious because they speak of more charges “if” there is plumbing issues, etc. I always pride myself on treating Airbnb homes as I would my own, so that was kind of nerve wracking to be on top of the group making sure there was no violations so I wouldn’t be charged extra. ***Overall this is a beautiful place and a entertaining spacious space. I would recommend this place.

name: Leticia
text:
Great host, easy to reach.
House very nice and lots to do specially with teens. Close to everything. Mountain to skii and city to enjoy handcrafted beverages.
We loved staying there.

name: Batya
text:
This place is amazing
absolutely what I expected based on the photos.
If you are considering this spot- book it!
Eddie was a great host
Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to our needs. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful.
The apartment was very clean and well stocked. We could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place, we had the best time and would stay here again easily!

name: Kj
text: This was the best experience ever, I loved it and he’s a great host

name: Abraham

Our group had a great weekend overall!

name: Andrew

First time Airbnb users. Great space. Ample bed space and comfortable mattresses. Nice decor and we enjoyed playing pool and the board games after our long, adventurous days in the area.

name: Michael

We loved using the grill, fire pit, hot tub, and endless games available. Wei's communication is by far the best and fastest I have ever experienced on Airbnb. We had no issues and would stay again.

name: Romina

name: Marisa

name: Chris
text: We loved our stay at Wei's house. There were so many great amenities, the home was spacious and Wei was communicative and accommodating. The house was conveniently located as well. We would definitely recommend this house!

name: Diana
text: We were very delighted with our stay!! Very accommodated and welcoming place to stay. All our concerns and questions were responded very quickly! Excellent place and convenient location.

Climate control worked perfect and house was stocked with dishes, places to eat and hang out etc. Would definitely stay here again.

name: Jen
text: Wei was an amazing host and our family had a wonderful week! The house is beautiful and we enjoyed the scenery! Thanks for having us!

name: Pinchas
text: Pictures don’t do the house justice. So nice and perfect for a family getaway. Will definitely use Wei as a host in the future!!

name: Jesus
text:
My family and I had a great time at Weis's airbnb for the 4th of July weekend. Very clean, spacious and beautiful. Thanks to the amenities that the home provided, there was never a boring time! Also, the location was great since there were lots of options for outdoor activities and food shopping nearby.

Wei is a great host and will go above and beyond to ensure that guest feel welcomed and have everything that they need. I definitely recommend staying at this airbnb!

text: We appreciate this amazing host. he was able to respond us quickly each time and help us out. the house had so many activities we could do, with 10 people the house was still very big!

Beautiful, cozy and spacious home that is perfect for a family get together or a getaway with friends. Please of amenities for kids (and adults) to stay entertained indoors and outdoors. The location is convenient for getting around the area.

Wei is a great host- very prompt and clear in communication. Would absolutely consider staying at this lovely house again in the future.

name: Jebreel
text: Amazing and beautiful home! We enjoyed our stay!

name: Grace
text: Stayed here as a group of 8 and had a wonderful time. Plenty of space and bathrooms, as well as spectacular amenities. (We loved the hot tub and movie room) House was clean, organized, and well stocked with everything necessary for our stay, all details were thought of by the owners. They are wonderful hosts and provided fast, reliable communication through the duration of our stay. Would definitely recommend staying here and would stay here again in the future!

name: Angela
text: Absolutely beautiful place and extremely friendly host!

name: Julie
text:
Two families (10 people) + 2 dogs stayed for an extra long weekend. The house is styled so well, with so much to do for everyone that we couldn’t do it all. The area is fantastic lots of hiking, outdoor adventure activities, restaurants and breweries to visit, near by.
The host provide great communication and are quick to respond if you need anything.
Overall a great visit!

name: Thao
text: The place is spacious and detailed. The host was very attentive and was ready to answer all of my questions.

name: Moin
text:
The house is amazing, filled with many amenities and sources of entertainment. The poker table and the grill were the highlights of our stay. The hosts are very responsive and the location is very nice as well (we saw a deer in the backyard!!)

Overall, highly recommended for a group of people.

name: George
text: Amazing house and amazing host! Checkin and checkout is seamless, hosts are incredibly responsive and attentive. Would definitely come back!

name: Matthew
text: 8 of us stayed at this lovely, very very spacious home for a hiking vacation. Sat on front porch and saw deer across street a few times. Drive slow as deer crossings in the neighborhood. Host Wei was very very responsive prior to our arrival and also during our stay. Great hiking trails within 15 min drive like Camelback Mountain. Less than 5 min to convenience store and 5 to 10 min drive to grocery stores and restaurants so very convenient. The refrigerator/freezer and washer/dryer were amazing and appeared almost new. Forever Fitness F2 was a great daily fee gym only about 7 min away as well. Lots of free weights and machines. My 3 adult children and 2 of their cousins enjoyed playing pool and poker on the poker table in basement while others could relax upstairs in quiet. Overall, awesome place for our extended family hiking trip and hope to be back next year. Thanks Wei!!!

name: Eunju
text: Wei was very prompt with his response and the place is very spacious for our family. We enjoyed our stay.

name: Nancy
text: My family and I had a wonderful stay at the property. Looks exactly like the pictures. The house was clean and we enjoyed the firepit in the backyard. The host was quick to respond to any inquiries we had before and during our time there. Overall great stay and would recommend if visiting the area.

name: Shahada
text: We had so much planned to do outdoors but ended staying in the house because it was so comfy & relaxing .

name: Kendyll
text: Great house in a beautiful location. Perfect for a group. If you plan to cook, I'd recommend bringing a large mixing bowl (only had small ones), and potentially a non stick pan (they have a few but they're well-loved).

name: Salli
text: House was great- it was clean, updated and had everything you can think of. Easy check-in. The only thing I would mention was we were really looking forward to using the hot tub but could not even get into the garage (space that has the hot tub) because of the extremely strong chlorine scent. It was actually unbearable and we had to keep the door closed or you could smell it from the living room. Other than that, my family and I had great time :)

name: Jessica
text: Place was amazing. All personal touches thought of. Well designed and well planned we did not have to leave for anything. Owner was responsive and flexible with allowing us to have our private chef come to cook for us. Great location will be booking again.

name: Betsy
text: Wei was amazing! He definitely replied to all my messages! This was my first air bnb experience and it will be hard to top! The house was amazing and so fun!! A lot of activities for everyone.

name: Ramon
text: Great space looks exactly as advertised. The host communicates well and the location is 20 minutes from most famous spots in the area.

name: Shantel
text: Very nice place and the host was fantastic. Me and my family had a wonderful time there

name: Tim
text: House was amazing! Very clean and tidy with plenty of amenities for everyone. Location was great and was easy to get everywhere we wanted to go. Communication was amazing and if we needed help we got answers immediately.

name: Duston
text: Our stay at wikicabin was awesome! Wei was a great host with absolutely excellent communication. The house was great and our whole group had a blast. Excellent location near major attractions like the raceway, casinos, water parks, breweries and more. Would definitely recommend!

name: Manoj
text: Great location and great place with lots of amenities that was provided by Wei. Super fast communication as well.

name: Ashanti
text: this house is amazing for family time and the experience was amazing and wei has great communication and making sure that his guest are well taken care of .

name: Damien
text: This is a great house plenty of room snd entertainment. From the large living room tv, the two separate movie theater rooms with projectors. It will plenty for guests with nearby attractions. I dont see this often but some of the best hosts i ever had the pleasure of having from a air bnb to even surprising us with mini breakfast from Dunkin Donuts theu make you feel right at home. Would love to stay herew again you will not regret staying here at all!

name: Nallely
text: Went with 3 other couples (family) to celebrate the guys birthdays and I cannot express how amazing this place was. The stay was AMAZING, the game room was exceptional and it gave that “having a good time” vibe. The beds were comfy, clean, clean home, the host, Wei was fast responsive and helped out with any questions asked. I will love to come again during a warmer weather as well since the cold & little bits of rain messed up us hanging outside by the firepit but I recommend this to anyone.

name: Beth
text: Great place for our family weekend. Very clean. We were snowed in and had lots of fun things to do. Plenty of room and nicely decorated. Host was very responsive to all inquiries.

name: Lisa
text: House is very well equipped and clean. The amenities were great, and enough to keep the adults and children entertained. Hosts were responsive and thoughtful. Overall had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend and return for another trip!

name: Christina
text: This house was perfect for families. Our kids absolutely loved the downstairs with all the amenities. They were kept busy with the all the games, theater and the outside space and fire pit. The house was clean, modern and decorated beautifully. It was also close to shopping and the ski mountains. I would highly recommend this house. The hosts were accessible and easy to communicate with.

name: Kristen
text: House is well equipped, clean, loaded with amenities to keep everyone entertained without leaving, while also being close in proximity to skiing and many other local attractions outside the house. Kids loved the big screen tvs/projectors, air hockey, “swing” seat, and pool table. Large basement bedroom was chilly but small space heaters (provided) helped. Hosts communicated clearly, were responsive and available if needed. Would definitely recommend!

name: Dani
text: Wei was such an incredible host! The house was beyond wonderful and I can't wait to come back again :)

name: Tameca
text:
Booked the home as a quick getaway ski trip with some close friends. There were 9 ppl in my group. The house was nothing short of amazing.
Pros:
-Communication from the host was very much appreciated. I sent messages and received a response within mins and other times a response was received within seconds.
-The house is located down the street from Kalahari and 45 mins away from Montage Ski Resort which is where my group went.
-Shopping stores and food places are within 3 miles of the home.
-The bedrooms and bathrooms were of decent sizes and the decor made it feel like a home away from home.
-The kitchen was equipped with pots and pans which we used and the bag of ice in the freezer was very much appreciated.
-The basement was everything for our trip! We all were in the basement during quiet hours as there is so much to do down there. Some played pool, some sang karaoke, some played Uno. We even had a cozy movie night in the basement.
-The garage was also everything for our trip. The sauna and hot tub soothe the bodies of those that went skiing.

Minor con: 2 of the guests complained that their bedsheets were dirty and had to wash the sheets. Was not a big deal as the washer and dryer are in the house.

Thank you Wei for a trip to remember and we will be booking again soon :-).

name: Jahnita
text: The House Was Amazing & The Backyard Was A Perfect Spot For Our Pictures 😁 The Background Is Beautiful When It Snows .

name: Raymond
text: Great place with lots of space and amenities!

name: Joe
text: A non-stop weekend of gaming! Options are endless in this house. The kids absolutely LOVED it! Hot Tub was a hit, air hockey, pool table was perfect, card table kept us busy for hours, and of course foosball was great! To end the nights, the kids watched movies or played games on the big-screens! My favorite aspect was the 2 different game rooms, the lower level and the converted garage. The kids were able to separate girls and boys and alternate and no one ever fought over a space because there was so much to do! In addition, the game rooms were separated from the living room so the adults could watch TV in peace while they played. I also appreciated the self check-in/check-out process. This saved significant time going to a location to get and return a key. Overall, this was an amazing weekend and the kids had so much fun.

name: Mariah
text: This is perfect for large groups, looks better than the pictures, and the host is super nice and quick with responding back. It is very clean, and has plenty of games and entertainment for all ages. All of my guests loved their stay so much, they want to book for their own events. I would definitely recommend!

name: Carina
text:
My first airbnb experience and it definitely sets the bar high. This stay was an amazing getaway my family and I needed. Booked on Jan 1 for jan7-8 for 8 adults and a one year old.
Although we stayed for two nights,I wish there was flexibility of the extension time. Especially because I had thought my interest of the stay prior to booking came off strong. I was very excited and interested in this space right off the bat and booked moments after a brief conversation of the airbnb overview with host..
I then Reached out about the possible stay extension two days after booking and the price for an extra stay was extremely high and the host did not seem to reason or negotiate. Instead said, Seconds later after I mentioned the price may not be reasonable for me but We could really enjoy the extra day, host said the airbnb was booked.

I read the comments and some guests seemed to have a stronger hospitality connection with the host and due to this stay being a birthday celebration, I expected a warmer welcoming or fluxation with the extra stay..
We scheduled our shower times apart although the downstairs bathroom shower water never got hot.. luckily the house’s heating was very warm.

Decoration of the host and furniture detail were perfect and even had pots and pans available to use in pantry!

Host is very quick to respond in 5-10 minutes and the house overall is bigger than the photos seem. I wish I were able to stay longer to enjoy the hot tub and fire pit but there was a storm the morning of checkout. Also, checkout seemed rushed as it was 11 am.

name: Phet
text: Great hospitality and attention to detail! Perfect for families!!!

name: Aleah
text: Best Airbnb our group has stayed at by far. Exactly like the pictures! Host has fast response time and always available. Will definitely be staying here again!

name: Abel
text: Amazing location. One of the best AirBnBs I've ever stayed in.

name: Valerie
text: This was by far one of the best airbnb experiences my group has ever had. We usuay always go away around this time and this place seemed too good to be true at first glance. The home is exactly as pictured if not better! There was always something to do and we were never bored. The host does an amazing job of making sure that you dont evene need to leave the house to have a wonderful vacation. Seeing the beautiful deer upclose and enjoying all the amenities in the house left me and my friends excited to stay here again! 100% reccommend to anyone. The home was clearly well maintained and provided so much entertainment that we only had to leave the home for groceries. On top of all the amenities included this wonderful home was pet friendly and truly worth the stay.

name: Angela
text: Excellent communication with host. Property better than photos. Amenity rich property with attention to detail. Well stocked kitchen, comfy beds, clean house, close to many attractions, can't wait to book again!

name: Janaina
text: Great location, beautiful home and so many great amenities. Open communication with owner at all times. Would definitely go go back again.

name: Vimal
text:
What a great house! Large. Accommodating. Full of everything you would need. Clean, two movie theaters and all of the furniture was
Comfortable. Comfy mattresses as well

Wei was extremely responsive. Often responding in 5-10 minutes.

Rules are very straightforward and pets being allowed is a huge win.

Would 100% stay here again.

Also amazing touch. They provided a Christmas tree as well.

name: Mauricio
text: We had a great experience with this rental! Wei, the host, was really responsive and super helpful. I also love the fact that they are friendly to dogs. I recommend this place!

name: Catalina
text: Amazing house and hosts. Very communicative. They know how to well decorate their house and make you feel at home with all the details and decoration and more!

name: Josabell
text: Loved the home, host where responsive to messages, the home is exactly what it looks like online. The amenities were fantastic. The pool table stole the show. Job well done!

name: Denise
text: Perfect house for a getaway with family and friends. This house was beautiful and had all the amenities you need. It was very spacious and a lot of entertainment available. House was very clean and beautifully decorated. Wei was a great host and also very attentive. Book this house, you'll have no regrets!

name: Mirza
text: Wei’s spot is amazing! If you’re visiting poconos it is near everything you need and very accommodating. The space looks even bigger in person than the pictures show. We visited when it was cold out but we felt at home with the warmth of both the Hot Tub and fireplace. We hosted a friendsgiving and anything we forgot to bring, the place was able to provide! Wei especially made it super easy to make cocktails. To top it all off, you can be stuck in this house and NEVER get bored. The host does a fantastic job of providing fun games etc. I would 10/10 recommend this spot.

name: Jose
text: Very nice place and well located. The sound rules are important, so review before booking. Wasn’t a problem for us though. Will definitely consider coming back.

name: Kristen
text: Perfect home for large families! Wei was great and answered any questions we had almost immediately. The home is beautifully decorated, very clean and has everything you could want to make your stay enjoyable. We would come back in a heartbeat!

name: Phi
text: This house was the perfect weekend getaway in the Poconos! Everything about the stay was just perfect. It was clean, spacious and had enough fun activities for everyone to enjoy for the 3 nights we stayed. Wei, the host was super responsive with our questions. We would definitely come back again.

name: Brandi
text: This property is well maintained and exactly as presented in photos, and the amenities were wonderful! Wei was courteous, helpful, and quick to respond. We loved our stay and will be recommending to others for sure!

name: Athina
text: You won’t regret booking this house! It’s probably one of the nicest Airbnb homes I’ve ever stayed in. Wei was an amazing host and my group would love to book again soon.

name: Annie
text: My friends and I were able to have a little getaway and enjoy this beautiful property. It was in a quiet neighborhood and we were able to enjoy the home and everything in it. I would definitely recommend a stay and would book again myself!

name: Ashley
text: We celebrated my husband’s birthday this weekend at this AirB&B. We had an amazing stay. The house was very clean and organized. It had everything we needed for a fun weekend away. The amenities were awesome and made for a very fun weekend. The host is wonderful and very responsive to any questions you have. I would stay here again.

name: Eunice
text: What a beautiful house! Our group had a great stay and were able to partake in all the amenities the house had to offer. From the game areas to the theater rooms to the hot tub and fire pit outside, we were constantly entertained throughout our stay. The property was very clean and looked even better than it does in pictures. The beds were comfortable and everyone had a place to sleep. All the bathrooms were also very new and clean. Wei was quick to respond to a question I had. The house was easy to find and to get to, check-in was also easy. We all agreed we would definitely love to stay here again.

name: Chantal
text: This house is absolutely gorgeous. Looks exactly like the pictures. Wei is a great host! Any questions I had were answered right away. I would definitely recommend. I had an amazing time! Thank you so much for having us in your lovely place. 💕

name: Christian
text: If you're looking to travel to the Pocono Mountains, THIS IS THE PLACE TO STAY. Our hosts far exceeded our expectations. They provided playpens and high chairs for my infant daughter and nephew, WITHOUT me having to request them. It's things like this that leave a lasting impression. As far as the house is concerned, everything was implacably situated. Cleanliness, convenience, and service were all top notch. I can safely say, I'll be booking with Wei and Yue again soon.

name: Eddie
text: Very nice and spacious house with plenty of amenities to entertain! Would definitely stay here again

name: Leslie
text: The host was great, they responded quickly. Everything was accurate, the house was beautiful!
